reviews.title: Joke of an app
reviews.text:
– Sucks

reviews.title: Widget on iPad doesn’t recognize paid subscription
reviews.text: The iPad widget says Pro subscription is required. I have paid that a month ago. The regular iPad app works, buy the widget doesn’t.  ZERO response from the app developers
